subscriptionDoctor.title: Subscription Doctor
subscriptionDoctor.subtitle: Read-only analysis of effective nodes without storing node bodies or credentials.
subscriptionDoctor.emptyResourcesHelp: Add a subscription or collection in Sub-Store first. This plugin does not add a URL or local-parser bypass.
subscriptionDoctor.noReportsHelp: Choose a source and start a check. Only the latest 20 redacted summaries are retained.
subscriptionDoctor.noChanges: This is the first report for this source
subscriptionDoctor.copyFailed: Copy failed. Use the download button instead.
subscriptionDoctor.loadFailed: Unable to load Subscription Doctor data
subscriptionDoctor.checkFailed: The check failed. Verify the source state and retry.
subscriptionDoctor.reportNotFound: This report could not be found
subscriptionDoctor.privacy: Reports exclude servers, passwords, UUIDs, tokens, private keys and complete subscription URLs.
subscriptionDoctor.checkScope: Checks structure, duplicates, four-client compatibility, security settings and node profile
subscriptionDoctor.fourClientOverview: Surge, Quantumult X, Clash and Loon
subscriptionDoctor.mediaLabelsHelp: These are labels found in node names, not proof that the node passed a real streaming unlock test.
subscriptionDoctor.networkUnsupportedHelp: The current Node backend cannot route requests through SS, VMess, VLESS, Trojan, Hysteria and similar nodes, so it does not fabricate latency, unlock, or egress reputation results. Real results will appear here after an optional node probe is available.
subscriptionDoctor.scopeNotice: This check covers final node structure, duplicates, and duplicate names. It does not test latency or reachability. Verify final Surge, Quantumult X, Clash, and Loon compatibility in Config Generator target previews.
subscriptionDoctor.actionDescription: Only issues that affect use or node identification are shown, with a concrete next step.
subscriptionDoctor.allClearDescription: {count} nodes were recognized with no structural errors, duplicates, or duplicate names.

SUBSCRIPTION_EMPTY.title: No effective nodes
SUBSCRIPTION_EMPTY.impact: Clients cannot connect or build usable policy groups.
SUBSCRIPTION_EMPTY.suggestion: Check the source URL, processing scripts, and filters to make sure every node was not removed.

NODE_PROTOCOL_MISSING.title: Node protocol is missing
NODE_PROTOCOL_MISSING.impact: Sub-Store and clients cannot determine how to parse the node.
NODE_PROTOCOL_MISSING.suggestion: Check whether parsing or processing scripts removed the type / protocol field.

NODE_SERVER_MISSING.title: Node server is missing
NODE_SERVER_MISSING.impact: The node has no connection destination and cannot be used.
NODE_SERVER_MISSING.suggestion: Check the original node URI and processing scripts, then restore the server field.

NODE_SERVER_INVALID.title: Node server format is invalid
NODE_SERVER_INVALID.impact: Clients may reject the node or connect to the wrong address.
NODE_SERVER_INVALID.suggestion: Remove protocol prefixes, paths, query strings, or whitespace from server.

NODE_PORT_MISSING.title: Node port is missing
NODE_PORT_MISSING.impact: Clients do not know which port to connect to.
NODE_PORT_MISSING.suggestion: Check the original subscription and processing scripts, then restore port.

NODE_PORT_INVALID.title: Node port is invalid
NODE_PORT_INVALID.impact: A port outside 1–65535 cannot be connected to.
NODE_PORT_INVALID.suggestion: Use an integer port and check whether a script converted it incorrectly.

NODE_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.title: Required credential is missing
NODE_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.impact: The node may be missing a UUID, password, key, or another required credential.
NODE_REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING.suggestion: Verify the original node URI is complete and scripts did not remove credential fields.

NODE_NAME_MISSING.title: Node name is empty
NODE_NAME_MISSING.impact: The node is difficult to identify and select in policy groups.
NODE_NAME_MISSING.suggestion: Add a name containing a region, protocol, or sequence number in subscription processing.

NODE_EXACT_DUPLICATE.title: Exact duplicate nodes found
NODE_EXACT_DUPLICATE.impact: Policy groups contain repeated entries and extra selection or latency-test noise.
NODE_EXACT_DUPLICATE.suggestion: Add node deduplication or check whether multiple sources import the same nodes.

NODE_NAME_DUPLICATE.title: Different nodes share a name
NODE_NAME_DUPLICATE.impact: The nodes cannot be distinguished reliably in policy groups.
NODE_NAME_DUPLICATE.suggestion: Add region, protocol, route, or sequence suffixes to duplicate names.

NODE_COUNT_DROPPED.title: Node count decreased since the last check
NODE_COUNT_DROPPED.impact: The upstream source, filters, or processing scripts may have changed.
NODE_COUNT_DROPPED.suggestion: Confirm the reduction is expected; otherwise inspect source status and recent processing changes.

NODE_TLS_SERVER_NAME_MISSING.title: TLS node has no server name

NODE_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT.title: Node uses a private or local endpoint

NODE_PLAINTEXT_PROXY.title: HTTP / SOCKS transport does not use TLS

NODE_LEGACY_CIPHER.title: Node uses a legacy Shadowsocks cipher

NODE_ENDPOINT_SHARED.title: Multiple nodes share the same server endpoint

GENERIC.title: Subscription needs review
GENERIC.impact: This issue may affect normal use or node identification.
GENERIC.suggestion: Return to the subscription or collection editor, inspect sources and processing rules, then run the check again.
